notes.title: Patch Notes
notes.content:
[h2]General[/h2]
[list]
[*]Added Unit Frames for Group Members in the bottom-left corner, allowing you to easily track the status of your teammates from anywhere.[/*]
[*]Added a compass to the top of Extraction's UI to better track the positions of your teammates.[/*]
[*]A small note will be displayed while waiting for a Match's Game Server letting the player know it could take a few minutes. Ideally, we can remove the wait and remove the message, but we haven't had time to address the root cause yet.[/*]
[/list]
[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Mastery should be properly applied after the Player's first Match.[/*]
[*]Mobile Mentality should apply to Rain Cloud.[/*]
[*]Talents in the Change Specialization menu should be properly displayed the first time the menu is opened.[/*]
[*]Matches should be terminated early if no one connects to it.[/*]
[*]Players should be removed from an Extraction Match after teleporting to safety, allowing you to queue for another Match without waiting for the first one to end.[/*]
[*]Fixed an hole in The Desert that could trap clumsy players.[/*]
[*]Removed a floating Treasure Chest from Extraction.[/*]
[*]The Black Widow's and Shaman's Lifeline Rituals should properly apply to the Black Widow and Shaman instead of their minions.[/*]
[*]Locked Enchantments should no longer be able to be selected.[/*]
[/list]
